name: Selenium-Driverless
notes: GitHub now serves the repository as ttlns/Selenium-Driverless, and the README marks the project out of maintenance. It installs from PyPI as selenium-driverless and needs Python 3.8 or later with Google Chrome installed.
summary: A Python browser automation library for Google Chrome that runs without chromedriver, offering element lookup, pointer clicks, multiple tabs, isolated incognito contexts and network interception.
